[[XL Center]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= |conf_wins_vacated=7}} {{2017–18 American Athletic Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 UConn Huskies men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Connecticut]] in the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Huskies were led by sixth-year head coach [[Kevin Ollie]]. The Huskies split their home games between the [[XL Center]] in [[Hartford, Connecticut]], and the [[Harry A. Gampel Pavilion]] on the UConn campus in [[Storrs, Connecticut]] as members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 14–18, 7–11 in [[2017–18 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in eighth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2018 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] to [[2017–18 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team|SMU]]. The school announced on January 26, 2018, that the NCAA was investigating recruitment of at least three basketball players for possible recruiting violations.{{Cite news|url=http://www.courant.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/hc-sp-uconn-men-ncaa-investigation-20180126-story.html|title=NCAA Investigating UConn Men's Basketball Program; Inquiry Includes Recruitment Of At Least Three Players|last=Amore|first=Dom|work=courant.com|access-date=2018-01-31|language=en-US}}{{Cite news|url=https://abcnews.go.com/Sports/wireStory/uconn-confirms-ncaa-investigation-mens-basketball-52628213|title=UConn men's basketball under NCAA investigation|work=ABC News|access-date=2018-01-31|language=en}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/ncaa-investigating-connecticut-mens-basketball-program/|title=NCAA investigating UConn men's basketball program|work=CBSSports.com|access-date=2018-01-31|language=en}} On March 10, the school fired head coach Kevin Ollie for just cause related to the NCAA investigation.{{Cite news|url=http://www.courant.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/hc-sp-uconn-ollie-fired-20180310-story.html|title=Kevin Ollie Fired After UConn Claims 'Just Cause'; Coach Says He Will Fight|last=Amore|first=Dom|work=courant.com|access-date=2018-03-12|language=en-US}} On March 22, 2018, it was announced that the school had hired [[Dan Hurley]] as head coach.{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22862828/dan-hurley-leaves-rhode-island-become-uconn-men-basketball-coach|title=Dan Hurley leaving Rhode Island, named head coach at UConn|last=Goodman|first=Jeff|date=March 22, 2018|access-date=March 22, 2018|website=ESPN.com}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/aac/2018/03/22/dan-hurley-become-next-head-coach-uconn/448420002/|title=Dan Hurley to become next head coach at UConn|work=USA TODAY|access-date=2018-03-22|language=en}} On July 2, 2019, the wins for the 2017–18 season were vacated due to NCAA Sanctions. == Previous season == The [[2016–17 Connecticut Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 16–17, 9–9 in [[2016–17 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in a tie for fifth place. They defeated [[2016–17 South Florida Bulls men's basketball team|South Florida]]{{Cite news|url=http://www.courant.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/hc-uconn-game-aac-south-florida-0310-20170309-story.html|title=UConn Battles, Defeats South Florida, 77–66; Houston Up Next Tonight|last=AMORE|first=DOM|work=courant.com|access-date=2017-10-24|language=en-US}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2017/03/09/purvis-scores-30-to-lead-uconn-over-usf-in-aac-tournament/98992014/|title=Purvis scores 30 to lead UConn over USF in AAC Tournament|work=USA TODAY|access-date=2017-10-24|language=en}} and [[2016–17 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]]{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400945787|title=Connecticut vs. Houston – Game Recap – March 10, 2017 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-10-24}} to advance to the semifinals of the [[2017 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] where they lost to [[2016–17 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]].{{Cite news|url=http://www.courant.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/hc-uconn-men-vs-cincinnati-aac-tournament-20170311-photogallery.html|title=UConn Men vs. Cincinnati AAC Tournament|last=Courant|first=Hartford|work=courant.com|access-date=2017-10-24|language=en-US}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
